dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and irregular closed-loop structures exhibit a sharp transition from a dark charcoal-colored exterior to a lighter, silver-grey interior. The perimeter geometry is non-uniform, showing fragmented and serrated edges particularly in the mid-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density is highest in the upper-mid lateral region, where asymmetrical clusters of solid high-intensity silver-white pixels are concentrated. These clusters are closely grouped with minimal inter-blob spacing, lacking internal tonal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the center of the frame form an obtuse triangle, with the longest edge oriented longitudinally along the dorsal-lateral axis.
